assumptions: The baseline training parquet has columns named user_id and target; the baseline already uses target as the item identifier.
Training items with no training interactions receive suffix token 0 because their r and p are both defined as zero by the specification and no within-decile training quantile can be fitted for them.

Quantile bins are assigned by stable rank within each training frequency decile, with ties resolved by input item order. This avoids ambiguous duplicate quantile edges while retaining the specified 3-bin and 2-bin quantile assignments.

The baseline collision-extension columns are retained and the demand token is appended as the final SID column, with values 0 through 11; the baseline codebook and model configuration remain unchanged.
